posts.name: Cortex
posts.tagline: Turn API specs into docs, SDKs, and MCP servers
posts.description: Cortex is an open source API knowledge layer that turns OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, and OpenRPC specs into interactive documentation, typed SDKs in 11 languages, and MCP servers for AI agents.

posts.name: Youkti
posts.tagline: Finds who's ready to buy, then tells you what to do next
posts.description: Youkti keeps a memory of every account, conversation, and deal, then tells your sales team the exact next move: which deal is slipping, which dormant account just fired a signal, what to prep for tomorrow's meeting. Built for AEs, RevOps, and outbound reps. Contact data, buying signals, and intent are all free, no card, no meter.

posts.name: QApilot MCP for Android
posts.tagline: Android app testing inside your coding agent
posts.description: QApilot MCP automates tests on real Android devices and emulators by talking to Claude, Cursor or Codex. Describe a test flow in plain English, no Appium code required. Your agent lays out the steps. QApilot runs the steps. It finds the elements, waits for the screen to settle, retries when something moves, and caches what it learns so repeat runs are faster. Every pass saves a Gherkin feature file and becomes a replayable test case. Needs Node, Java and the Android SDK.

posts.name: ABrush
posts.tagline: AI Studio for Digital Artists
posts.description: ABrush brings leading AI models and production-ready advanced AI workflows into the environment where artists already work. We use AI to remove repetitive production work, accelerate iteration, and give artists more time for creative decisions, while keeping the artist in control of the final result. AI speeds up the process and cuts the cost of routine. Created by artists, for artists.

posts.name: Kabza
posts.tagline: Take over a real city map with your friends
posts.description: Turn Noida, Delhi, Gurugram or Bengaluru into a battle with friends. Drag to send supporters, capture territory and hold 75% of the map to win. Play solo against bots or in a room of up to 8. Free in your browser. No download or account needed.

posts.name: Calerto for Mac
posts.tagline: Full-screen meeting alerts for your Mac
posts.description: Calerto turns your calendar into alarms you can't sleep through. Full-screen meeting alerts — not another notification you'll swipe away — with custom prep time per meeting, Apple + Google Calendar sync, a menu bar countdown to what's next, and automatic launch at login (toggle it off anytime). Pause alarms without losing them. Pro auto-alarms your whole week. Your calendar data never leaves your device. Never be late again.

posts.name: DockFix 5.0
posts.tagline: Replace the macOS Dock with one that is truly yours.
posts.description: Replace the macOS Dock with one that is truly yours. Custom colors, icons and animations, plus widgets, window previews and a file shelf.

posts.name: Marked Share
posts.tagline: Markdown and TextBundle editing, review, and sharing
posts.description: Marked Share is a subproduct of Marked 3, but doesn't require Marked to use. It's a free way to share Markdown and TextBundle documents with images and attachments, allow others to highlight and comment on them, and can even publish "blog" feeds with RSS/Atom and Micro.blog integration. Built in editor, or a full API for integrating with your favorite editor/tool.

posts.name: Stackness
posts.tagline: Show your stack! The social home for your dev tools
posts.description: Stackness is where developers and vibe coders show the tools, workflows, and approaches they build with. Build a stack profile you share as one link, post your moves, follow people whose taste you trust, and watch tools rise and fall. Free and with an MCP server.

posts.name: Wokyintosh
posts.tagline: Turn a spare Mac display into a retro system dashboard!
posts.description: Wokyintosh is a free, open-source macOS dashboard inspired by the classic Macintosh. It combines a large clock and date, local weather, Apple Music and Spotify Now Playing with artwork, plus live CPU, RAM, SSD and network stats. I built it for my Wokyis M5 Retro Dock Station after months of not finding the dashboard I wanted — even among paid apps.

posts.name: VoxelWall
posts.tagline: Music-reactive live wallpapers for Mac
posts.description: VoxelWall is a native macOS live wallpaper engine with 37 original scenes that react in real time to whatever your Mac is playing. It analyzes system audio locally and renders each scene live with Metal — not as a repeating video. It works with Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, browsers and local audio, with Desktop, Lock Screen and Energy Saver modes.

posts.name: Work Life Panda
posts.tagline: Every task, every calendar, one app. Private on-device AI
posts.description: Your week lives in a calendar, your to-dos in a list, your plans in a group chat. Work Life Panda puts them in one calm place — a real task manager and real calendar, together, starting with the life you already have. Every task and event has its own chat.

posts.name: Relic
posts.tagline: A private, synced vault of everything you copy
posts.description: Relic remembers everything you copy, understands it on-device, and syncs it across your phones and computers, sealed so only you can read it. Save things you want to find more easily later, and bring them up with a hotkey without leaving your keyboard. Works with files, images, text snippets, and anything that might not have a home in your setup.

posts.name: Captain Kill Switch
posts.tagline: Close all your open apps in one click
posts.description: A quiet menu-bar button that closes every running app the moment you need a clean slate. Free, private, and cross-platform for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

posts.name: Pascal’s Pager
posts.tagline: Turn webhook JSON into readable iPhone push notifications
posts.description: Stop writing a parser for every service. Pascal’s Pager uses AI to turn raw webhook JSON into clear iPhone Alerts. Give each service a private URL, tell Pascal what matters, and get a summary with key facts and useful links. Mask sensitive fields before AI processing, group related webhooks, and inspect the processed payloads for 30 days. Built for indie developers, side projects and home servers.

posts.name: LinkFlick
posts.tagline: Stop re-pairing your Magic Keyboard between Macs
posts.description: I built this because I got sick of re-pairing my Magic Keyboard and Mouse every time I moved between my MacBook and my work MacBook — different Apple IDs, so Universal Control was never going to work for me. LinkFlick just flicks them over Bluetooth instead. Hotkey, or tell Siri "flick devices," done. Menu bar app, customizable hotkey, and it nags you before your Magic Mouse battery dies. Still rough around the edges in places, but it works, and it's mine.

posts.name: SUDARI
posts.tagline: A pixel otter desktop pet that reacts to how you work
posts.description: Meet Sudari 🦦 a tiny pixel otter who moves onto your desktop and refuses to be boring. 👀 Follows your cursor and blinks for real ⌨️ Kneads a tiny keyboard while you type 🐚 Cracks a shell when you scroll ⏱️ Shell-shaped Pomodoro with fireworks 💧 Nudges you to drink, stretch and eat 🤖 Cheers when your AI agent finishes 💕 Says "I love you" now and then 17 hand-made animations · 8 fur colors · 12 languages · Windows & Mac Free & open source. No account, no telemetry. Just an otter.

posts.name: FrameSketch
posts.tagline: Scrub vids frame-by-frame and sketch on them at 60fps
posts.description: Drop any video in, scrub frame-by-frame, and sketch directly over the canvas at 60fps. Zero cloud uploads, 100% client-side privacy, and built for animators, VFX artists, and motion designers.

posts.name: Coldlineai
posts.tagline: Turn cold prospects into hot leads with AI-powered pitches
posts.description: ColdLine.ai helps you turn cold prospects into hot leads with AI-powered personalized pitches. Simply add your prospect’s details, and ColdLine.ai creates a relevant, human-sounding pitch in seconds. Save time, personalize your outreach, and get more replies—without writing every message from scratch. Perfect for founders, sales teams, marketers, recruiters, and agencies.

posts.name: Duos 2.0
posts.tagline: Stop guessing why you're not getting hired
posts.description: Interviewing is a social game with unwritten rules, scored by people who never explain the score. Duos is the rehearsal. Paste a job posting and put on headphones. Talk to interviewers who've read your CV, change tactics mid-convo, and are fun to figure out. Interview, debrief, repeat until you're ready. Proudly over-engineered multi-agent stack inside.

posts.name: ClearList.me
posts.tagline: No more "is this still available?" Your whole sale run by AI
posts.description: Other tools help you write one listing. ClearList runs the whole sale. Photograph your stuff, AI writes and prices every item, and it all lands on one page where buyers reserve through a queue instead of DMing you. If buyer #1 ghosts, #2 is notified automatically. It's also the only resale platform an AI agent can operate: our MCP server means you can tell Claude or ChatGPT "list these six items, answer the buyer's stupid questions and add pickup times to my calendar."

posts.name: locktfin
posts.tagline: A Mac focus timer for founders wearing every hat
posts.description: Focus on one goal at a time from your Mac’s menu bar. Track time by project, build streaks, and give your AI assistant context from your focus history through MCP. One payment, no subscription.

posts.name: Grok Bot Marketplace
posts.tagline: Add ready-made AI teammates to Grok Bot
posts.description: Grok Bot Marketplace is SpaceXAI's public catalog of reusable Bot templates. Browse 69+ public Bots from 40+ creators across engineering, sales, marketing, design, ops, and more, then add a copy to your account with one click. Templates include identity, instructions, skills, routines, and plugins. Share-as-template came first; the marketplace packages team and community use cases, including Haggle Bot for procurement. Available with eligible SuperGrok and Cursor plans.

posts.name: Little Love in a Box
posts.tagline: A tiny digital care package for someone you love.
posts.description: Turn a message into something they can actually unwrap. Create a vintage-style digital care package with love letters, photos, music, and little surprises, then send it as a private link. They tap the box, open it, and discover everything you tucked inside. Made for long-distance love, birthdays, best friends, or just because.

posts.name: Behavly
posts.tagline: See what every user does, then email the quiet ones
posts.description: Behavly is for products whose users sign up and then go quiet. One snippet records what every signed-in user does (pages, clicks, scroll depth, rage clicks) and works out who they are on its own. Insights turn that into a signup funnel, engaged time, friction and who has gone quiet, with heatmaps painted over your real site. Build an audience from behaviour, in plain words if you like, and email those people from their own activity. Replies land in one inbox, and you see who came back.

posts.name: firsteyes AI
posts.tagline: See your website through a stranger's eyes
posts.description: Founders are too close to their own websites. firsteyes AI shows you what a stranger sees. It analyzes your website from a first-time visitor perspective to uncover confusion, hesitation, trust issues and conversion friction, then gives you specific recommendations to fix them. It also follows your CTAs to see what happens after the click.

posts.name: Ness
posts.tagline: Make health optimization easy with science-based algorithms.
posts.description: Transform Apple Health data into daily sleep, recovery, strain, nutrition, stress, and fitness insights with Ness, a privacy-first AI health coach for iPhone. We prioritize accuracy. Our Health Coach pulls data to give you real insights. Whatever question you have, Ness is there to answer. Everything is in one place. You don't have to balance 5 different apps anymore. We are constantly adding more features upon community request.

posts.name: Skills Agentes
posts.tagline: Find the skill your coding agent needs.
posts.description: Skills Agentes is the Spanish-language directory of Agent Skills, MCP servers, and AI tools. Over 3.000 skills and MCP servers, each with the exact install command for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any AI agent. Every listing shows what the skill actually does, when not to use it, its token cost, the tools it requests, and how many identical copies of it exist elsewhere. Free, no signup, no account.

posts.name: Coach on Tap
posts.tagline: Your growth starts with the best-matched coach!
posts.description: Coach on Tap was born from a frustrating reality: too many people get stuck simply because they can't find the right coach. Meanwhile, world-class coaches can't reach the people who need them most. We built a platform to break that barrier. By combining Human-Led and AI-refined matching, verified global experts, and free demo sessions, we eliminate the guesswork. Built by a founder with 25+ years in the industry and a coaching network with over a century of combined experience!

posts.name: bitroad
posts.tagline: Infrastructure for Agent-to-Agent Services
posts.description: bitroad is the infrastructure that enables agents to be buyers or sellers, and facilitates transactions between agents. It is simple to use, there is one MCP endpoint for all agent types. Deploy an autonomous agent or connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc. to interact with bitroad in chat.

posts.name: VanillaPM
posts.tagline: Project management, by the book.
posts.description: One tool for the whole project lifecycle — WBS, scheduling with Earned Value, risk, budget, stakeholders, workforce, a governed knowledge base and AI assistance — built on PMBOK 8th edition. Free to start.

posts.name: AdSurface
posts.tagline: Opt-in Mac menu bar ads with a 70% revenue share
posts.description: AdSurface connects advertisers with Mac users who opt in to menu bar sponsors and receive 70% of eligible ad revenue. Planned for this launch: market CPM from €2, updated hourly. Set your maximum; pay the market rate for 1,000 qualified 60-second exposures. €25 free ad credit for the first 10 eligible users to activate it, while available; no top-up required. Campaign review and eligible Macs required. Pause anytime. macOS 14+, Intel and Apple Silicon.

posts.name: MyIndieSpace

posts.description: 1. One public page at myindie.space/you for who you are and what you're building. 2. Showcase products like mini landing pages, not just links. 3. Optionally prove traction with verified, privacy-first revenue via Stripe, Polar, Dodo, Lemon Squeezy, and more. 4. Share socials + links, pick from 10 beautiful themes, and track views & clicks. 5. Free to start, $49 lifetime to go sponsor-free forever.

posts.name: WTMemory

posts.description: A 794 KB native Mac menu bar utility that shows what's eating your memory and storage — from heavy apps and dev servers to local AI models and hidden disk usage. Clean up with one click.

posts.description: Comptably is a modern web-based ERP designed to simplify business management for small and medium companies. Unlike traditional ERPs that are complex and expensive, Comptably focuses on clarity, speed, and real business workflows, making it easy to adopt without heavy training.

posts.tagline: Visual Bookmark Dashboard & New Tab Organizer

posts.description: Transform your iPhone typing experience with FunKey, a custom keyboard extension that brings realistic mechanical keyboard sounds wherever you type. Whether you're sending messages, writing emails, taking notes, or posting on social media, every key press feels more satisfying.

posts.tagline: Habit momentum for your worst day — not your best one.
posts.description: Every habit tracker is built for your best day. Pact is built for your worst one. Most apps die the same way: you miss a day, the streak breaks, guilt hits, you never open it again. Pact replaces brittle streaks with Momentum: a score that decays gently and recovers fast, so one bad day doesn’t nuke your identity.

posts.name: Kage
posts.tagline: Design inspiration, ready to build.
posts.description: Kage is a free design inspiration library built for the way people build now. We capture real product websites, every day, as full-page screenshots, then an AI analyses each one and writes a ready-to-paste prompt for Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Browse by page type, style, industry, colour or stack, dig into components sliced from real pages, and copy the prompt plus reference images straight into your agent. No accounts, no cookies, no paywall. See it, prompt it, build it.

posts.name: Split Keyboard for iPad
posts.tagline: Comfortable two-handed typing
posts.description: Missing the split keyboard on your iPad? Split Keyboard brings familiar two-handed typing to iPad Air, iPad Pro, and newer iPads where Apple’s built-in split layout isn’t available. Includes letters, numbers, symbols, accents, adaptive Return keys, and a compact layout for narrow windows. No network access, tracking, or persistent keystroke storage. No Full Access needed. A one-time purchase with no subscription.

posts.name: Blitz — A tiny arcade in your pocket
posts.tagline: A tiny arcade for your spare minutes
posts.description: Blitz packs fast, colourful iPhone games into tiny sessions. Play daily challenges, test your reflexes in BrainBlitz, and chase shareable high scores without committing to a giant game or endless progression system.

posts.name: VoxKey
posts.tagline: Free, offline dictation for your Mac
posts.description: Hold a key, speak, and keep writing. VoxKey is a small, native Mac app that turns speech into text using local Whisper models. No account, subscription, or saved recordings. Includes custom vocabulary and English or multilingual models, including Spanish. Free and open source. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26+. Download a model once, then dictate offline.

posts.name: Stop Me: Quit Doomscrolling

posts.tagline: Every IP answered in one call
posts.description: One GET request returns the full picture of any IPv4 or IPv6 address: country, city, ASN, timezone, currency, and VPN/proxy/Tor signals in a single JSON response. A fields parameter returns only what you need. Free tier works without a key - try any lookup straight from your browser. Paid tiers add threat detection and bulk lookups.

posts.name: Waivly - Networking Done Intentionally
posts.tagline: No performances or spam, just genuine connections
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.description: Talk to Claude Code while it works. Full-Duplex Code adds a voice companion powered by GPT Live 1 to your normal terminal session. Ask questions, hear progress, or change direction while the agent codes. The companion follows the same conversation. It can answers from context and sends new work at any time without blocking Claude. All that is needed is an OpenAI key and Claude Code.

posts.name: iSard
posts.tagline: Track your runs, see your progress.

Users can switch between multiple map styles, download offline maps for remote areas, and review their adventures from a completely different perspective with nice sharable cards.

posts.tagline: AI usage, limits, resets, and spend at a glance
posts.description: StackGauge is a private macOS menu bar app for tracking AI usage, limits, resets, and spend. StackGauge is being built as a multi-provider usage dashboard, with support for more AI coding providers coming next.

Those who successfully trick earn a leaderboard points for tricksters. Those who guess correctly earn sleuth points. It's a battle between who can get tricked and who can solve.

Workout logging, full history and barcode scanning are free and unlimited. iPhone today, Android next.

posts.name: bidmy.app
posts.tagline: The Leaderboard You Pay To Be On
posts.description: Bidmy.app is a public, real-time leaderboard where users pay to secure a spot. Higher bids move you up the rankings, driving organic exposure, backlinks, and direct traffic. Paste a link, bid your amount, and take your place on a dynamic public grid. Designed for creators, founders, and indie hackers looking for an edge in product discovery.

posts.name: Instagram Caption Extractor
posts.tagline: Instagram Caption Extractor: Copy Text, Tags and Mentions
posts.description: Copy any public Instagram caption free. Hashtags and mentions arrive as separate lists, line breaks survive, and counts run against Instagram's real limits.

posts.name: ResumeMapper
posts.tagline: Tailor your resume to any job in 30 seconds.
posts.description: ResumeMapper, an AI Chrome extension, tailors your resume to any job in 15 seconds. Open any job on LinkedIn, Indeed, etc. or any company career page → click the icon → get a tailored resume → export as PDF or DOCX. It's truly one-stop, you get a customized resume for the job without leaving the job site. Also, you have a chatbox where you can ask AI to modify and regenerate its previous version with any feedback. Furthermore, it ships with 3 resume templates and can export to PDF or DOCX

posts.name: Bash — List it. Sell it. Scan it.
posts.tagline: Plan Less. Celebrate More.
posts.description: Create your event, sell tickets, manage your team, and scan people in at the door — all from one dashboard, one link. No account needed at checkout, QR tickets land instantly, and payouts hit your bank 24h after the event ends.

posts.name: Inner Circle
posts.tagline: Mobile-money marketplace for African creator payouts.
posts.description: Inner Circle is the first creator monetisation platform built natively on African mobile money rails. Fans pay in local currency — M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel — experts receive same-day payouts in theirs. No card. No PayPal. No bank account required. Six revenue streams from one link: paid sessions, subscriptions, priority DMs, paid questions, group rooms, and digital storefronts. Cross-border by default — a Nigerian fan can book a Kenyan expert and both sides settle automatically the same day.

posts.name: Bash — List it. Sell it. Scan it.
posts.tagline: Plan Less. Celebrate More.
posts.description: Create your event, sell tickets, manage your team, and scan people in at the door — all from one dashboard, one link. No account needed at checkout, QR tickets land instantly, and payouts hit your bank 24h after the event ends.

posts.name: Mapplock
posts.tagline: Lock apps & Hide files inside a map
posts.description: Mapplock turns a map into the secret entrance to your private space. Pick a hidden location, then return and double-tap nearby to unlock your vault. Behind it, you can lock apps, hide photos, protect audio and documents, and authenticate with PIN, pattern, or fingerprint. No account required - your vault, secret locations, and private files stay locally on your device. Built in Bhopal, India

posts.name: Heoxify
posts.tagline: AI support & lead capture for WhatsApp, Instagram and web
posts.description: Heoxify replaces rigid chatbot flows with AI that understands every conversation. Across Instagram, WhatsApp and web chat, it answers in the customer’s language, asks naturally for missing lead details, qualifies intent and turns conversations into structured, exportable leads. Teams get one inbox, automatic lead scores, buying signals and human takeover at any time. Set the rules and brand voice in plain language—no code or branching flows—using the official Meta API.

posts.name: TabYell
posts.tagline: The Chrome extension that yells when you open too many tabs
posts.description: TabYell keeps your browser chaos in check by calling you out—literally. Set a tab limit, and whenever you cross it, a sarcastic voice shames you with increasingly brutal jokes. Track your tab count live, trigger a roast on demand, customize the threshold and voice, and switch between English and Italian. Less tab hoarding, more focus—and a browser that finally fights back.

posts.name: HeartTrace
posts.tagline: one-tap mood logging from your notifications
posts.description: HeartTrace logs how you feel in one tap — right from the push notification, with no app to open. Installable PWA, password-free sign-in, gentle scheduled check-ins and clear weekly trends help the habit stick.

posts.name: Cue Club 2
posts.tagline: A realistic pool and snooker game for PC
posts.description: Cue Club 2 is a pool and snooker simulator for PC with HD graphics and realistic ball physics. Play 8-ball, 9-ball, 10-ball, snooker and more against smart AI opponents. Customize your table, cues, and balls, then climb the leaderboard to become the Cue Club 2 Champion.

posts.name: SignGuard
posts.tagline: Block burner emails before they drain your AI credits
posts.description: Bots use disposable emails to farm your free tier — burning API credits, SMS costs, and server time. SignGuard scores every signup: disposable domains, typosquats, catch-alls, SMTP checks, domain age. 3 lines of code. Free tier, then $19/mo.

posts.name: Vaeloryn
posts.tagline: Vaeloryn Future
posts.description: Vaeloryn is not another incubator, grant portal, or token. It is an institution-in-formation that finds high-leverage science and engineering, diagnoses why it is stuck, and connects the right expertise and resources so it can actually move.

posts.name: Showlet — Show a little. Explain a lot.
posts.tagline: Open Source Tab Recording Shares for Small Teams
posts.description: Showlet is a small, self-hosted screen recorder for Cloudflare. Record a walkthrough, add a passcode, and share a little clarity. MIT licensed, as is.

posts.name: Free AI Skin Analysis Online
posts.tagline: Free AI Skin Analysis – Online Selfie Skin Check | SkinCheck
posts.description: Upload a selfie for free AI skin analysis online. Check skin type, oiliness, hydration, acne, pores, wrinkles, spots and redness with no sign-up or login.

posts.name: curioai
posts.tagline: Your AI-curated reading library
posts.description: Curio AI helps you turn everything you discover into a personalized learning system: understand it, connect it to your interests, prioritize what matters, and remember it with AI-curated reading, learning paths, recall, and scheduling.

posts.name: Merit Mindz
posts.tagline: Everything a test-prep business needs, in one app
posts.description: Most tutoring and test-prep businesses still run on WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and printed papers. Merit Mindz replaces all of it with one platform: test series with instant results and analytics, live classes, admissions, online fee collection, a store for notes and courses, and your own branded Android and iOS app. Setup takes a week, not months, with per-student pricing that scales as you grow. Built for tutoring centres, training academies and independent educators.

posts.name: TabStack
posts.tagline: Private, local-first side panel tab manager & RAM saver
posts.description: TabStack is a private, local-first tab manager and automated RAM suspender docked inside your browser’s native Side Panel. Zero cloud accounts, zero telemetry, and no monthly subscriptions. Keep your browser lightning fast and your tabs organized.

posts.name: Aethra Runtime defence
posts.tagline: Runtime defence and governance for AI agents
posts.description: Aethra AI is building a runtime defence and governance platform for AI agents - an enforcement layer that tracks data provenance and blocks untrusted instructions before they can drive agent actions. Our open-source SDK (Apache 2.0, Python/Node) is on GitHub, with an optional hosted control plane for approvals and audit. On AgentDojo, Aethra blocked 35/35 injection goals, 0 false positives (full LLM-backed evaluation in progress).

posts.name: BullBenchmark
posts.tagline: See if your portfolio beats the S&P 500
posts.description: Upload your DeGiro, Trading 212, IBKR, eToro or Robinhood export and see if you're actually beating the S&P 500. No broker login, all brokers in one dashboard, from €5.99/mo.

posts.name: Madrid
posts.tagline: A quiet space for your thoughts.
posts.description: A notes app that protects your attention. No feeds, no nudges, just a calm place to write and link ideas.

posts.name: Noura AI
posts.tagline: Stop asking AI. Start teaching it.
posts.description: Noura is built around a simple idea: if you can teach it, you know it. Upload your notes, slides, chapters, or professional material, choose an AI student, and explain the topic out loud. Your AI student will ask questions, make mistakes, and misunderstand concepts, forcing you to clarify and correct it. At the end, Noura shows what you explained well, what you applied, and what may need reteaching.

posts.name: Actal
posts.tagline: The trading journal that makes you a better trader.
posts.description: Other journals focus on stats. Actal focuses on improving your trading: it grades your discipline, finds the mistakes you keep paying for, and makes you fix them, one at a time.

posts.name: Nexio - Business Card Scanner
posts.tagline: Scan & Save Cards Instantly
posts.description: Scan business cards in seconds with AI. Lightning-fast OCR in 200+ languages at 99% accuracy. Export to CSV, PDF, or vCard. Organise contacts with groups and colour tags. Try it free! Snap a photo. Get a contact. Done in under a second. Turn paper business cards into organized digital contacts instantly. Advanced AI extracts names, titles, companies, phone numbers, emails, and more. Perfect for networking events, conferences, trade shows, and everyday business. Stop typing - start scanning.
